items.title: 130-ton electric trucks 4,000 feet beneath the surface of the Earth [video]
items.summary: Swedish mining company LKAB is putting a pair of massive, 130-ton GVW electric Scania haul trucks to work at its Malmberget iron ore mine – which happens to be more than 4,000 feet below the surface of the Earth.

items.title: Data centers can vanish from the grid in seconds; reliability rules need to catch up

items.title: E-quipment highlight: 4,400 hp Wabtec FLXDrive electric locomotive
items.summary: After nearly a year of operation on a dedicated track line at the Jimblebar iron ore mine in Australia, BHP is proving that these 4,400 hp battery-electric powered heavy-haul locomotives are ready for prime time.

items.title: Court Backs New York Approval of $1B Williams Gas Pipeline
items.summary: A revived pipeline proposal advances after years of permit setbacks, as regulators now cite new technical findings on sediment disturbance, burial depth and marine impacts.

items.title: PJM eyes option to jumpstart surplus interconnection pathway
